description.value: An fMRI ICA study examining how left frontoparietal network activity during erotic, aversive, drug-related, and neutral cue-reactivity stimuli differs between abstinent cocaine-dependent men and healthy controls.

spans.text: In the present study, we used ICA to investigate the effects of cocaine addiction on the modulation of functional networks while processing drug cues, erotic cues and aversive cues.
